tooltip.full: Full — this run read the whole disk. It restores on its own.
tooltip.incremental: Incremental — this run only read the blocks that changed since the last one. It still restores on its own; it doesn't depend on the full.

restorePoint.selfContainedNote: Every point is independently restorable — “full” vs “incremental” is about how much data was ingested, not a restore dependency.

consistency.quiescedTip: VMware Tools quiesced the guest before the snapshot, so applications and databases had flushed their data to disk.

reason.tools_not_installed: Crash-consistent: VMware Tools is not installed in the VM, so the guest was not quiesced.
reason.tools_not_running: Crash-consistent: VMware Tools was not running in the VM, so the guest was not quiesced.
reason.quiesce_failed: Crash-consistent: quiescing the guest failed, and the job is set to take a crash-consistent backup instead of failing.
reason.not_quiesced: Crash-consistent: VMware Tools did not quiesce the guest.
